content.finding: Governed LF work can drift when a reusable skill is entered before Router-first verification.
content.desired_outcome: Operational requests that touch governed LF assets begin with Router → public.v_lf_fuente_operativa → active asset before a skill or adapter is activated.
content.proposed_improvement: Treat Router-first compliance as the reusable entry condition for governed LF work and validate it through the learning quality gates before any impact.
content.review_scope: Quality Pack reviews evidence, reuse value, governance boundaries and whether the candidate is sufficiently complete to continue without inventing missing intent.

proposed_next_action: Review the included learning candidate with Quality Pack; do not recreate it.
